'''''Rebel Force: Renegade''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] junior novel written by [[Alex Wheeler]]. It is the third installment in the series ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Force]]'', and it was first published in [[May]] [[2009]] by [[Scholastic]].
